conclusion: All three reviewer conclusions are supported by the cited evidence (ev-misev2023-quality-framework). The MISEV2023 guidance endorses orthogonal characterization, controls, transparent reporting, and validated functional assays and therefore supports the reviewers' positions that (a) program-specific CMC/analytics deliverables are required and were not supplied in the allowed evidence set, (b) scale-up and lot-to-lot reproducibility are not demonstrated in the supplied evidence, and (c) rodent-only biodistribution is insufficient without orthogonal intact-EV analytics and bridging controls. No reviewer assertions rely on evidence outside the allowed evidence ID.
